task:
PAUSE THE JOURNAL RESEARCH EXPORT (OWNER DECISION D4).

WHY: docs/ROADMAP.md records owner decision D4 (2026-10-21): "the journal research export is to be paused (switched off, with a note saying why) until it can carry colonisation events the CRE can use — as of this entry the export route is still mounted and has not been switched off." Section 2 of docs/development/evidence/2026-10-21-cre-cpe-utilisation-audit.md gives the reason: the export carries only exploration and exobiology events (the allowlist in apps/api/src/edfinder_api/journal/sanitize.py), the V3 journal allowlist has no colonisation events, and nothing on the CRE side ingests the batches, so they are written and go nowhere.

REQUIRED BEHAVIOUR, in apps/api/src/routers/v3_journal_research.py only:
1. One module-level constant RESEARCH_EXPORT_PAUSED = True, with a short comment that gives the why and points to ROADMAP decision D4. It is not an environment variable or setting: turning the export back on must be a reviewed code change, because it first needs colonisation events.
2. While paused, POST /api/v1/journal/research-exports refuses with HTTP 503 and never reads consent or calls the export builder. PUT /api/v1/journal/research-consent with decision GRANT refuses the same way before any consent read or write, because a grant for a paused export would mislead. The refusal's detail uses the problem-details shape already used for 503s in apps/api/src/routers/archetypes.py (type, title, status, detail) plus one stable machine-readable member, reason: "research_export_paused". Its detail text says in plain words that research exports are paused because they cannot yet carry colonisation events the CRE can use. In both routes the existing authentication (_require_user) and same-origin check still run first, unchanged, so an anonymous or cross-origin caller gets exactly what it gets today.
3. Unchanged while paused: PUT research-consent with decision WITHDRAW, including its supersede of lineage batches (withdrawal must always work); GET research-consent; GET research-exports; GET research-exports/{export_batch_id}. People can always see and withdraw their own records.
4. Response models, operation ids, rate limits and OpenAPI stay unchanged. Do not add responses= entries, so no client regeneration is needed. Do not touch apps/api/src/edfinder_api/journal/ (consent, export, sanitize), the migrations or the web app.

TESTS:
- tests/integration/test_v3_journal_research_flow.py is the route-level suite (real PostgreSQL). Keep every existing flow that covers the export builder and the consent machine, by turning the pause off for those tests with a fixture that monkeypatches RESEARCH_EXPORT_PAUSED to False (never by editing the constant). Add paused-route tests in the same module: POST export returns 503 with reason research_export_paused and writes no research_export_batch row; PUT GRANT returns 503 and writes no consent row; an account that already holds a GRANT can still WITHDRAW while paused, and its batches are still superseded; the three GETs behave as before; the existing auth and origin test keeps its current status codes.
- Add a database-free unit test module, for example tests/test_v3_journal_research_pause.py, that drives the router through FastAPI with the pool and user dependencies stubbed. It proves the 503 detail shape, that the export builder and consent recording are never called while paused, and that WITHDRAW is not refused.
- This runner has no PostgreSQL: run the database-free tests and ruff, and say plainly that the integration module was not run. The reviewer runs it on PostgreSQL 18.

DOCS: in docs/ROADMAP.md's D4 sentence, replace "as of this entry the export route is still mounted and has not been switched off" with a dated note that the export was paused on 2026-11-01 by RESEARCH_EXPORT_PAUSED in apps/api/src/routers/v3_journal_research.py: new exports and new grants are refused with 503 research_export_paused, and withdrawal and reads are unchanged. Add a CHANGES.md entry at the top, in the file's style.

CHECKS TO RUN: `ruff check apps tests scripts shared_contracts`; `ruff check --select B905 apps tests scripts shared_contracts`; the new unit module; and the full database-free unit suite, `python -m pytest -q tests/ --ignore=tests/integration`, which must pass (report the counts).

FINAL ANSWER: the changed files with one line each, the new code for both refusals, and the check results.
